content:
mia: quick heads-up — proposing we strip cluster-admin from the deployer service account used by the model-puller in ml-serving. it currently has broad perms to mount secrets and describe nodes; we should limit it to exactly what it needs (secrets/get, pods/get, pods/exec?). also need a plan for KMS decrypt access for ephemeral tokens to fetch model blobs.
arjun: +1 on least-priv. question: can we delegate KMS Decrypt to a separate KMS-decrypt SA instead of giving the deployer SA that IAM role? worried about blast radius.
leo: absolutely. pattern: create a namespaced Role for k8s secrets + a ClusterRole for the KMS-decrypt proxy SA that has the KMS IAM binding. call out Workload Identity or IRSA depending on cloud.
sam: noticed a spike in "kms:Decrypt denied" errors after last rollout (logs pasted below). we should add auditing filters before we flip perms.
sam: ```text
[2026-03-14T13:02:11Z] kube-audit: serviceAccount:ml-serving:deployer denied secrets/get 
[2026-03-14T13:02:11Z] kms:Decrypt denied for key projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/rw-keys/cryptoKeys/weights
```
dev-platform: suggested rollout plan: 1) create new kms-proxy-sa with KMS decrypt binding 2) create Role that allows token-exchange (sts:impersonate style) 3) deploy a tiny proxy (sidecar) that runs under kms-proxy-sa and only exposes Decrypt over a local unix socket 4) flip deployer to call local socket. test in canary namespace.
mia: sounds good. rough Role YAML for ml-serving (namespaced) — please sanity-check: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: ml-serving-deployer-minimal
  namespace: ml-serving
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
```
arjun: looks good. for KMS side, i'd prefer a ClusterRoleBinding only if the proxy needs cross-namespace access. otherwise keep it namespaced. and add audit annotation on the RoleBinding so our audit pipeline tags requests coming from this flow.
leo: add this ClusterRole for the proxy SA if we need to list nodes for health checks: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: kms-proxy-health
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["nodes"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
```
dev-platform: migration checklist (short): 
• create kms-proxy-sa + KMS IAM binding (Audit: IAM policy change ticket)
• deploy proxy in canary ns and validate decrypts via test harness
• update deployer images to call socket (feature flag)
• add audit filters and dashboards for "kms:Decrypt denied" and "secrets/get denied"
• rollback plan = flip feature flag back + re-add role if necessary
security-bot: ALERT: created ticket SEC-2026-87 for KMS IAM binding review (link: https://redwood.internal/SEC-2026-87) :white_check_mark:
mia: one more thing — any objections to adding a brief Declarative Audit rule so that any future change giving cluster-wide secret access triggers an automated policy review? I can draft a Kyverno policy.
arjun: +1 please do. kyverno will help but add a CI gate so PRs that touch Roles/ClusterRoles in `ml-` namespaces require two approvers from eng-security.
sam: i'll stub the dashboard queries today. will check the canary logs for unexpected 403s.
leo: ok i'll own the KMS proxy container image (small glibc+gRPC shim). aim to have a dev image in 48h.
mia: thanks everyone. action items documented in SEC-2026-87. tagging @dev-platform for rollout coordination. :rocket:
